every runtime claim requires a SUCCESSFUL COMPILER REBUILD. A build failure alone is NOT a substitute for a runtime observation.
the mutated source MUST have a different SHA-256 from the pristine source
the rebuilt driver subject MUST have a different SHA-256 from the pristine subject, unless the mutation provably cannot change the bytes
the mutated compiler MUST be the binary the observation was taken from, identified by its own SHA-256
the mutation MUST be confined to the named range; the diff is recorded and the rest of the file MUST be unchanged
no mutation may be made in an unrelated semantic function; the diff is the witness
the source MUST be restored byte-for-byte and the restoration SHA recorded; a dirty worktree after the experiment is a FAILURE
each mutation runs in a DISPOSABLE DETACHED WORKTREE with its own build directory; the authoritative checkout is never mutated
the compiler invocations are SERIALIZED, because /tmp/holyc-asm.s is a shared scratch path
statement

if the chosen PolyC action mutation is causally DECORATIVE -- the artifact class does not change -- the experiment HALTs with HALT_CAUSAL_OR_DORMANCY_UNPROVEN. A decorative export is not an authority.
if the ON build STILL changes when the legacy C decision is mutated, the experiment HALTs with HALT_CAUSAL_OR_DORMANCY_UNPROVEN. The legacy rule is still authoritative.
if a required artifact cannot be produced for ANY reason other than the mutation itself, the observation is REPORTED as NOT_REPRODUCED, never as a pass.
if the G0 oracle cannot be rebuilt independently of the mutation, the comparison is REPORTED as UNAVAILABLE, never as agreement.
if a producer generation is an ALIAS of another rather than an independent producer, the claim that depends on its independence is HALTED with a PRODUCER_ALIAS marking.
